cohort: The cohort consisted of preterm infants born with a birth weight less than 1500g and gestational age less than 32 weeks, who experienced at least one episode of suspected late-onset sepsis between 2018 and 2023.
finding: Elevated IL-6 levels are associated with increased odds of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) over late-onset sepsis (LOS), but its moderate predictive value indicates it is insufficient for accurate early diagnosis or differentiation on its own.
